properties.html: A shopkeeper purchased 8 identical toys at the same price: He sold exactly one of the toys on each day for the next 8 days. If the profit he earned on a day was double the profit he earned on the previous day, and the profit earned on the first day was 12%, then by approximately what percentage is the total cost of 8 toys less than their total selling price?
